items.evidence: Reservoir slot 1 and plate slot 2 loaded with the required labels; p20 left and p300 right with matching tip racks in slots 10 and 11.
Loops over plate.rows()[0] (A1-A12), aspirating and dispensing 100 uL from reservoir A1; end_state:plate passed and nothing else is touched.
Uses p300 for 100 uL in a single aspirate/dispense per well, within pipette limits.
A fresh tip per well is valid, with a tip always held and dropped, but it wastes 12 tips where one reused tip would do for a single reagent into empty wells.
apiLevel 2.15 is in range and metadata is clear, but a blow_out at dest.top() after each dispense is an extra move, and the tip never touches liquid for reservoir aspirations with default heights.
Performs only the single requested 100 uL transfer to A1-A12; comments and metadata are accurate.

judge.summary: The protocol meets the task: 100 uL goes from reservoir A1 into each of plate A1-A12 with the p300, and all measured checks pass. Minor inefficiencies are the new tip for every well and the extra blow_out after each dispense.
